concerns.text: Spec edge case 'catalog missing a required column (e.g., velocities) → Halt execution with explicit error message' has no implementing task. T107 covers only the 300-particle boundary, failed NFW fits, and KDE fallback. Add a task (or extend T107) to implement and test the halt-on-missing-column behavior.

Spec assumption 'Sensitivity analysis for environment overdensity threshold sweeps values over a range of Mpc h⁻¹ and reports how halo classification rates vary across this set' has no corresponding task in any phase. Either add a task producing a threshold-sweep artifact or the assumption is uncovered.

concerns.location: spec.md:SC-003 / Constitution VII vs tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage
concerns.text: SC-003 (corrected p-values measured against α=0.05) and Constitution VII (significance thresholds pre-registered in the analysis script) have no task pinning the α threshold in code/config.py or verifying significance against it. The schema's `significance` field alone does not cover the pre-registration requirement.

T101 instructs loading `code/contracts/raw_halo.schema.yaml`, but no such contract exists — plan.md and data-model.md define only `halo.schema.yaml` and `results.schema.yaml`. Stale reference to a nonexistent plan element; the task's verification will fail on a missing file. Point it at `code/contracts/halo.schema.yaml` (or a raw-halo schema added to the plan).

Header claims 'Previously verified tasks are preserved as checked', yet every listed task T003–T030 is an unchecked `- [ ]` box (only T031–T035/T037 are `[X]`). The completion state is ambiguous to an implementer; reconcile the checkboxes with the claim.
